title: Cylindrical body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a 2D sketch consisting of two concentric circles. The first circle has a center at coordinates [0.0233, 0.0233] and a radius of 0.0233. The second circle shares the same center but has a smaller radius of 0.02. Scale this 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0467. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no additional transformation is required. Extrude the scaled 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the extruded sketch into a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body will be a length and width of 0.04666666666666666 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the pen
r = r.center(0.0233, 0.0233) \
     .circle(0.0233) \
     .circle(0.02)

# Extrude the sketch to create the pen body
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0233, 0.0233)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0233)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0199)  # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a solid cylinder of diameter 0.0466 and height 0.75
part1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0466 / 2).extrude(0.75)

# Create a hollow cylinder of diameter 0.0466, wall thickness 0.0046,
# with a height of 0.75
part2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(0.0466 / 2)
    .circle(0.0466 / 2 - 0.0046)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

# Subtract part2 from part1 to get a hollow tube
r = part1.cut(part2)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Hollow cylinder (pipe)
outer_radius = 0.0466 / 2.0   # 0.0233
length = 0.7500
wall_thickness = 0.0033
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness

# Outer cylinder
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_radius).extrude(length)

# Inner cylinder to cut out
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_radius).extrude(length)

# Final hollow tube
r = outer.cut(inner)
